basis: Alopecia, neurodegeneration and pituitary failure define syndrome; kyphoscoliosis/contractures 4/5; dental abnormalities 3-5/5 omitted by cap.
Reported hereditary cutaneous hyperthermia; underlying pathology unclear. Headache, nausea and fever alone do not establish additional organ damage.
Malignancy originates in or infiltrates bone marrow; marrow involvement does not itself establish skeletal damage.
Intraepithelial neoplasia confined to the prostate, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Glaucoma and sleep apnea with respiratory insufficiency define the syndrome; both reported in 80-99%.
Cytogenetically defined acute myeloid leukemia involving blood and marrow; no common additional organ damage established.
Umbrella for anaerobic bacterial infections at diverse sites; no anatomical organ applies across most subtypes.
Joubert brain malformations and developmental impairment; rod-cone dystrophy with night blindness in 4/4. Renal lesions each 1/4, below threshold.
Trichinella directly infects intestine and skeletal muscle in its defining phases; cardiac, pulmonary and CNS complications are rare.
Tertiary syphilitic infection with destructive gummas; skin, bone and liver sites vary, without an established organ-specific frequency of at least 30%.
Vertebral and long-bone dysplasia with enchondromas; pretibial blistering and skin erosion reported in 80-99%. Neurologic findings below 30%.
Inherited vesicoureteral reflux affects the urinary tract; unspecified skeletal abnormalities lack sufficient evidence for inclusion.
TUBB2A-related brain malformations, severe developmental delay and seizures define this neurodevelopmental disorder.
Intestinal neuromuscular dysfunction causes impaired propulsion; neuropathic and myopathic subtypes do not establish generalized nerve or skeletal muscle disease.
Psychological response to occupational demands; no direct damage to an organ axis is defined.
Primary CNS neoplasm arising from parenchymal cells of the pineal endocrine gland.
Parasitic infection directly occupies and damages the eye or ocular adnexa.
Inherited atrial electrical dysfunction causing atrial fibrillation; no additional organ disease established.
Stenosing wrist tenosynovitis affects tendons and their sheaths; association with rheumatoid arthritis does not make this inherently autoimmune.
Hereditary glaucoma causes ocular pressure abnormalities and glaucomatous optic nerve damage.
Leukocyte inclusions, anemia and leukemia define the blood disorder; atrial septal defect has no established frequency supporting inclusion.
Fanconi anemia subtype; radial-ray defects, facial palsy and PDA each reported in 1/1 patient. Ectopic kidney alone does not establish renal dysfunction.
Urethral sphincter dysfunction causes urinary retention and incomplete emptying. Polycystic ovarian morphology alone does not establish endocrine dysfunction.
Renal tubular chloride transport disorder causes salt and potassium wasting with hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis; hypokalemia in 17/17.
Small round cell sarcoma arising in mesenchymal soft tissue or bone; no common additional organ involvement established.
